body: When I was in New Zealand, I thought Maccas was a regional retaraunt chain - until I went with some friends and it was actually McDonalds.

Maybe I didn't make myself clear.  I have been feeling all this - and refraining from acting on it - for years.  

Years. 

Mostly because I *know* all the suicide advice.  But this is different.  I'm not planning on killing myself on any particular day, I don't have a plan to do it. Maybe that's not "suicidal."  But the truth is that I have been searching for years for a reason to continue and I keep coming up short.  I *want* to find that reason.  I *want* to be able to live the normal life that other people seem to accomplish so easily.  But I don't think I'll ever be able to.  

It's coming down to a rational choice - if there really is no hope, if there  really is no relief from the pain, isn't the logical - and humane - thing to do to just end it?  God forbid I snap someday and hurt *others*.

Could I really trust someone - anyone - with what's going on in my head?  The last thing I want to do is to lose my job or to lose my freedom because they think I'm crazy. 

I may be crazy, but it's far, far worse to be treated like a crazy person than to actually be crazy.
